items.title: Speech-to-Text Transcription
items.name: speech-to-text
items.description: Transcribe audio and video from YouTube, TikTok, podcasts, X, and 1,000+ other sites or any direct media URL into accurate, speaker-labeled text. Uses World's best speech to text AI models with automatic language detection, multilingual support, and smart formatting.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts running. Number of events charged depends on Actor memory (one event per GB, minimum one event).

video-processed.eventDescription: Charged once per Youtube video after the audio has been successfully downloaded. Covers the fixed cost of metadata lookup and audio retrieval

audio-minute.eventDescription: Charged per minute of audio transcribed by Deepgram, rounded up to the nearest whole minute. Only charged after transcription succeeds.

media-minute-transcribed.eventDescription: Charged per started minute of video or audio actually transcribed (rounded up per item). Same flat rate for video and audio; failed items are never charged.

audio-minute-transcribed.eventDescription: One minute of audio transcribed, rounded up per file. Transcription cost included — no API key needed.

audio-minute-byok.eventDescription: One minute of audio transcribed, rounded up per file. Discounted rate when you provide your own Deepgram API key.

transcription-second.eventDescription: Charged per second of audio/video duration (rounded to nearest second)

items.title: Whisper Speech to Text — Audio & Video Transcriber, Diarization
items.name: whisper-speech-to-text
items.description: Transcribe audio & video to text with Whisper — now with speaker diarization. Who-spoke-when labels (SPEAKER_1, SPEAKER_2…) on every segment, per-speaker summary rows, timestamped transcript, SRT/VTT subtitles, word-level detail, 99 languages. Batch URLs in, structured result rows out.

transcribed-minute.eventDescription: Charged once per result row delivered. Rows include the file summary, chapter rows, keyword rows and minute-block rows (each minute-block row carries one minute of audio with its transcript, segments and timestamps). Optional sentence-level segment rows are off by default and charged the same way when enabled.

items.title: Speech to Text — YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, 99+ Languages

Auto-detects 99+ languages, routes across Groq/OpenAI/ElevenLabs/Google with automatic failover, and returns text, SRT/VTT subtitles, and optional speaker diarization. Pay-per-event — no subscription.

audio-minute.eventDescription: Per started minute, charged only after transcription succeeds.

platform-video-fetch.eventDescription: Charged once per successfully downloaded platform video/audio (yt-dlp).

audio-minute-diarized.eventDescription: Per started minute with speaker labels, charged only after transcription succeeds.
